title: typed.v1 result rows
description: The row fields of a `fsnow.query.run.v2` envelope's `data` (also MCP query_run) when `row_encoding` is `typed.v1`. Every column's `json_repr` holds for all of its cells: validate cell i of every row against `$defs/cell_<json_repr of column i>`. SQL NULL is JSON null in every representation. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know.

type.description: The SQL API rowType type as sent (FIXED, NUMBER, REAL, DECFLOAT, TEXT, BOOLEAN, BINARY, DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP_NTZ, TIMESTAMP_LTZ, TIMESTAMP_TZ, VARIANT, OBJECT, ARRAY, ...).

cell_integer.description: FIXED/NUMBER with scale 0 and precision <= 15: an exact JSON integer.

cell_decimal_string.description: Other FIXED/NUMBER (never through a float) and DECFLOAT (which may carry an exponent): the exact decimal text.

cell_float.description: REAL/FLOAT: a JSON number, or one of the strings NaN, Infinity, -Infinity.

cell_date.description: DATE: proleptic Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD; years outside 0000-9999 keep their sign and extra digits.

cell_time.description: TIME: HH:MM:SS with nine fractional digits.

cell_timestamp_ntz.description: TIMESTAMP_NTZ: wall-clock date and time, no offset.

cell_timestamp_utc.description: TIMESTAMP_LTZ: the instant in UTC, RFC 3339 with Z.

cell_timestamp_offset.description: TIMESTAMP_TZ: local date and time with the value's own offset, RFC 3339.

cell_json.description: VARIANT/OBJECT/ARRAY: the parsed JSON value (a value holding a number JSON cannot carry exactly keeps the column on the wire instead).

cell_wire.description: Types without a typed form (GEOGRAPHY, GEOMETRY, unknown), and any column holding a cell that does not match its type's wire convention: the jsonv2 wire string.
